criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The mint function lacks overflow checks, which can lead to an attacker being able to mint an arbitrary number of tokens.
The mint function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The migrate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The value <= balances[msg.sender] check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The migrate function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set the balance of the migration master to any value.
